The Bruins, led by 33rd-year head coach [[Rick Byrd]], played their home games at the [[Curb Event Center]] in [[Nashville, Tennessee]] as members of the [[Ohio Valley Conference]]. They finished the season 27–6, 16–2 in OVC play to finish in a tie for the regular season championship with [[2018–19 Murray State Racers men's basketball team|Murray State]]. They defeated [[2018–19 Austin Peay Governors men's basketball team|Austin Peay]] in the semifinals of the [[2019 Ohio Valley Conference men's basketball tournament|Ohio Valley tournament]] before losing to Murray State in the finals. They received an at-large bid to the [[2019 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]], their first ever at-large bid, where they defeated [[2018–19 Temple Owls men's basketball team|Temple]] in the First Four before losing in the first round to [[2018–19 Maryland Terrapins men's basketball team|Maryland]]. On April 1, 2019, head coach Rick Byrd announced his retirement.{{Cite web | url=https://www.tennessean.com/story/sports/2019/04/01/rick-byrd-retiring-belmont-basketball-coach/3331413002/ | title=Belmont's Rick Byrd on retiring: 'It's a grind and it's just time' | website=[[The Tennessean]] }} He finished at Belmont with a 33-year record of 713–347. ==Previous season== The [[2017–18 Belmont Bruins men's basketball team|Bruins]] finished the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2017–18 season]] 24–9, 15–3 in OVC play to finish in second place. They defeated [[2017–18 Austin Peay Governors men's basketball team|Austin Peay]] in the semifinals of the [[2018 Ohio Valley Conference men's basketball tournament|OVC tournament]] to advance to the championship game where they lost to [[2017–18 Murray State Racers men's basketball team|Murray State]].
